name: Exodia
description: Exodia decks won by collecting all five pieces in hand. The April 2000 list limited each piece and Pot of Greed to one copy and Graceful Charity to two, making it harder to draw through the Deck.

defining_cards.name: Exodia the Forbidden One
defining_cards.why: Holding the head with all four limbs won immediately, giving draw and search cards a victory condition independent of combat.

defining_cards.name: Sangan
defining_cards.why: It could search any of Exodia's five pieces, turning a lost monster into progress toward the win condition.

defining_cards.name: Witch of the Black Forest
defining_cards.why: Its DEF-based search could fetch any missing piece of Exodia.

defining_cards.name: Graceful Charity
defining_cards.why: Drawing three cards let Exodia dig for a missing piece while discarding cards it could afford to lose.

defining_cards.name: Last Will
defining_cards.why: Losing a monster to the Graveyard unlocked a small monster from the Deck, converting a tribute into access to a searcher or combo piece.
